newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau trade surplus 262 million patacas in January.
newsitem.headline: Macau trade surplus 262 million patacas in January.

text.p: Macau had a merchandise trade surplus of 262 million patacas in January, versus a 45 million pataca deficit in the same month last year, the Macau Statistics and Census Department said on Friday.
Exports grew 37.6 percent year-on-year to 1.61 billion patacas, while imports increased 10.9 percent to 1.35 billion patacas.
Domestic exports, which accounted for 89.7 percent of total exports, rose 48 percent, while re-exports fell 15 percent.
Textiles and garments, taking up 86 percent of the total exports, rose 52.9 percent in January, when non-textile exports fell 14.9 percent.
